chapters.label: Two minutes on
chapters.text: Kyiv, 2018, the Champions League final. Real Madrid and Liverpool are level. Gareth Bale has just come on. Marcelo crosses from the left, but it drops behind him... so Bale kicks it over his head. Goal!

chapters.label: Back to goal
chapters.text: Watch again. His back is to the goal. Eyes on the ball, he swings his left foot up high.

chapters.label: Top corner
chapters.text: From behind the goal: it flies over the keeper, into the top corner. Madrid lead, two goals to one!

chapters.label: Be brave
chapters.text: Like Bale: be brave when the ball is in the air, and keep your eyes on it as you kick.
